The '''Double "V" Pattern''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] assault formation used when assaulting a heavily defended position. A wedge of ten [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] were employed to clear a path through the outer defenses, which were followed by a quartet of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]].
